wire_contract.canonicalization: RFC8785 JCS UTF-8; no BOM, whitespace, newline, duplicate keys, floats or unknown fields

issuer_freshness.challenge_id_profile: pchal_<RFC9562 UUIDv7>; lowercase canonical hyphenated UUID, version 7, RFC variant 10
issuer_freshness.uuid_timestamp: unsigned 48-bit Unix epoch milliseconds equal issued_at_utc seconds multiplied by 1000
issuer_freshness.uuid_randomness: independent CSPRNG 12-bit rand_a and 62-bit rand_b; time is validity only, never winner selection
issuer_freshness.nonce_encoding: independent issuer CSPRNG 256-bit nonce; exactly 64 lowercase hex characters
issuer_freshness.timestamps: real calendar UTC YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ; no offset, fractions or leap seconds
issuer_freshness.validity_rule: expires_at_utc minus issued_at_utc equals exactly 604800 seconds; accept issued_at_utc <= current UTC < expires_at_utc
issuer_freshness.clock_source: internal current UTC; production APIs expose no caller verification-time override

signature_profile.signature_encoding: exactly 64 Ed25519 bytes encoded as 128 lowercase hex characters
signature_profile.key_identity: signature key_id resolves exclusively through genuine canonical ProductionTrustContext.pdsa_keys
signature_profile.key_set_digest: exact verified Production Trust PDSA_KEY_SET_DIGEST; never a caller-selected or independently serialized key set
signature_profile.signature_order: 2 or 3 unique key_id entries in lexical order; every supplied signature must verify
signature_profile.external_signature_provider: receives only exact issuer-generated domain-separated signing bytes; output cannot alter payload and confers no authority before verification

digest_derivations.pdsa_challenge_digest_sha256: lowercase hex SHA256(exact canonical signed envelope bytes including signatures)
digest_derivations.pre_enrollment_request_digest_sha256: existing parent contract SHA256(exact canonical 22-field request payload bytes)

retention.custody_prerequisite: production service supplies its issuer-owned retained store; caller-selected filesystem paths, copies and software fixtures establish no issuer authority
retention.issued_publication: verify signatures and durably commit exact challenge ID, canonical bytes, whole-envelope digest and expiry as ISSUED before returning artifact
retention.consume_gate: genuine production_pre_enrollment.require_authenticated_pre_enrollment capability bound to exact source challenge store; public digest, PoP alone and booleans confer no acceptance authority
retention.atomic_consume: BEGIN IMMEDIATE; current UTC recheck; atomic ISSUED to CONSUMED with exact canonical request bytes, request digest and exact acceptance receipt bytes; SQLite WAL and synchronous FULL
retention.expired_unconsumed: terminal EXPIRED committed before reporting expiry; never resurrect after clock rollback
retention.same_request_retry: return only previously persisted exact acceptance receipt for exact challenge bytes and exact request bytes/digest, including after challenge expiry
retention.store_guarantee: crash/concurrency consistency under trusted issuer custody; SQLite is not independent rollback-protection authority
retention.package_issuance_boundary: receipt establishes pre-enrollment authentication acceptance only; any future package issuer must extend the same atomic retained consumption with exact package ID/digest/bytes before publication

verified_result.public_client_verifier: verify_signed_production_pdsa_challenge verifies current Production Trust quorum and challenge time; returns immutable PDSAEnrollmentChallengeV1 data only, with no retained ISSUED or consumption authority and no issuer-store access
verified_result.provenance: private verifier-issued object registry plus exact immutable byte/digest snapshot, context identity and source-store identity/path
verified_result.reverification: require_verified_issued_challenge rechecks current runtime trust via require_current_production_trust_context, signatures, unchanged snapshot, exact retained ISSUED and current challenge validity
verified_result.production_trust_prerequisite: require_current_production_trust_context accepts only runtime load_production_trust provenance and re-verifies its original package at current UTC; historical audit contexts and test loader mocks do not prove current runtime release authorization
